title: Palia Cozy Corner: The Glade is Growing
preview: We spent three hours decorating the plot and I regret nothing. The butterfly garden is complete.
full:
We spent three hours decorating the plot and I regret nothing. The butterfly garden is complete, the fishing spot has been upgraded, and chat collectively named the new plant corner 'The Glade.' I think that's permanent now.

Highlights: someone caught a golden trophy fish on their first cast, we had a full plot tour, and we planned out the next build phase together.

Next stream: tackling the indoor layout. Open to suggestions.

title: Ghost Hunt Notes: The Ghosts Are Listening
preview: We died four times and I screamed twice. Successful investigation by all metrics.
full:
Professional assessment: the ghost was a Revenant, chat called it before I did, and I owe everyone a follow for the correct guess.

We died four times. I screamed twice (both completely justified). The Spirit Box said something that still has me unsettled and I'm choosing not to repeat it.

Next hunt is already planned. Come for the ghost, stay for the chaos.
